My final fare is much higher than the estimate. Why?

Open the trip receipt and compare the route, trip time, waiting time, tolls, and any changes made during the ride with the original estimate. If something still looks wrong, choose the trip in the app and ask support to review the fare. The receipt and the app's terms determine what adjustments may apply.
